class=\"pre\">[source]</span></span></a></dt>\n<dd><p>Verifies an MFA code and completes authentication.</p>\n<p>Supports OTP, OOB (with binding code), and recovery code verification.</p>\n<p>If Auth0 returns \u2018mfa_required\u2019 again (chained MFA), raises MfaRequiredError\nwith a raw mfa_token. The framework SDK (e.g. auth0-fastapi) is responsible\nfor encrypting the token before returning it to the client.</p>\n<dl class=\"field-list simple\">\n<dt class=\"field-odd\">Parameters<span class=\"colon\">:</span></dt>\n<dd class=\"field-odd\"><ul class=\"simple\">\n<li><p><strong>options</strong> \u2013 Dict containing \u2018mfa_token\u2019 and one of:\n- \u2018otp\u2019: OTP code\n- \u2018oob_code\u2019 + \u2018binding_code\u2019: OOB verification\n- \u2018recovery_code\u2019: Recovery code\n- \u2018persist\u2019: bool (optional, default=False) - Persist tokens to state store\n- \u2018audience\u2019: str (optional, required if persist=True) - Audience for token_set\n- \u2018scope\u2019: str (optional) - Scope for token_set</p></li>\n<li><p><strong>store_options</strong> \u2013 Optional options passed to the State Store (e.g. request/response).</p></li>\n<li><p><strong>dpop_key</strong> \u2013 Optional EC P-256 JWK to DPoP-bind the token. Pass the same\nkey used at login (e.g. given to signin_with_passkey) to preserve\nthe sender constraint through step-up. Never stored by the SDK.</p></li>\n</ul>\n</dd>\n<dt class=\"field-even\">Returns<span class=\"colon\">:</span></dt>\n<dd class=\"field-even\"><p>MfaVerifyResponse with access_token, token_type, etc.</p>\n</dd>\n<dt class=\"field-odd\">Raises<span class=\"colon\">:</span></dt>\n<dd class=\"field-odd\"><ul class=\"simple\">\n<li><p><a class=\"reference internal\" href=\"/docs/sdk/python/server/reference/error/index#error.MfaVerifyError\" title=\"error.MfaVerifyError\"><strong>MfaVerifyError</strong></a> \u2013 When verification fails, or when dpop_key was supplied\nbut the server returned an unbound (Bearer) token.</p></li>\n<li><p><a class=\"reference internal\" href=\"/docs/sdk/python/server/reference/error/index#error.MfaRequiredError\" title=\"error.MfaRequiredError\"><strong>MfaRequiredError</strong></a> \u2013 When chained MFA is required.</p></li>\n<li><p><a class=\"reference internal\" href=\"/docs/sdk/python/server/reference/error/index#error.ConfigurationError\" title=\"error.ConfigurationError\"><strong>ConfigurationError</strong></a> \u2013 If dpop_key is combined with use_mtls. DPoP and mTLS\nuse incompatible token-binding mechanisms and cannot be used together.</p></li>\n<li><p><a class=\"reference internal\" href=\"/docs/sdk/python/server/reference/error/index#error.ConfigurationError\" title=\"error.ConfigurationError\"><strong>ConfigurationError</strong></a> \u2013 If neither client_secret nor client_assertion_signing_key is configured.</p></li>\n</ul>\n</dd>\n</dl>\n</dd></dl>\n\n</dd></dl>\n\n<dl class=\"py data\">\n<dt class=\"sig sig-object py\" id=\"auth_server.mfa_client.DEFAULT_MFA_TOKEN_TTL\">\n<span class=\"sig-name descname\"><span class=\"pre\">DEFAULT_MFA_TOKEN_TTL</span></span><em class=\"property\"><span class=\"w\"> </span><span class=\"p\"><span class=\"pre\">=</span></span><span class=\"w\"> </span><span class=\"pre\">300</span></em></dt>\n<dd></dd></dl>\n\n<dl class=\"py data\">\n<dt class=\"sig sig-object py\" id=\"auth_server.mfa_client.MFA_PENDING_IDENTIFIER\">\n<span class=\"sig-name descname\"><span class=\"pre\">MFA_PENDING_IDENTIFIER</span></span><em class=\"property\"><span class=\"w\"> </span><span class=\"p\"><span class=\"pre\">=</span></span><span class=\"w\"> </span><span class=\"pre\">'_a0_mfa_pending'</span></em></dt>\n<dd></dd></dl>\n\n</section>\n</section>";
